title: Long-Stay Discount on the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Fee
content:
A long-stay discount is taken off the protection fee of a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election, because a
guest buying cover for a long reservation buys it in bulk. The long-stay discount is the stay discount rate of
the figure it is taken off, expressed as a percentage of that figure, and it is taken off after the loyalty rate
has been applied and before the fee is held at the level's floor or under the trip ceiling. The reserved period
of the trip is read from the Keyturn Trip Booking beneath the election.

1. Where the reserved period of the trip runs for 60 days or more, 12.0 percent is taken off.
2. Where it runs for 30 days or more but fewer than 60 days, 6.0 percent is taken off.
3. Where it runs for fewer than 30 days, nothing is taken off and the rate stands at 0.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Days the reserved period runs for | Rate taken off |
|---|---|
| 29 | 0 |
| 30 | 6.0 percent |
| 59 | 6.0 percent |
| 60 | 12.0 percent |

A reserved period of exactly 60 days reaches the upper threshold and carries the 12.0 percent rate; one of
exactly 30 days reaches the lower threshold and carries 6.0 percent.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A fee of 800.00 USD on a trip whose reserved period runs 70 days has 12.0 percent of 800.00 USD taken off,
which is 96.00 USD, leaving 704.00 USD. The same fee on a trip of 40 reserved days has 6.0 percent taken off,
which is 48.00 USD, leaving 752.00 USD. The same fee on a trip of 9 reserved days has nothing taken off and
stands at 800.00 USD. In each case it is the figure reached after the discount has been taken off that goes on to
be held at the level's floor and under the trip ceiling.
